newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen in range but uptrend intact.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa seen in range but uptrend intact.

text.p: JULY Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
LIFFE cocoa futures remain in a range but the short term uptrend is intact after July closed above its 14- and 20-day moving averages on Tuesday, analysts said.

July was expected to open Wednesday down 10 stg, but Darren Gurner, analyst at Sucden, noted that Tuesday's close at 1,024 stg per tonne was above the 14-day moving average at 1,021 and the 20-day moving average at 1,014.
He said the close helped preserve cocoa's slow advance.
"The market is still in an upward channel," he said.
Gurner said the upper boundary of the upward channel extended from the April 30 high of 1,007 and the lower part started from the May 1 low of 981.
Initial July cocoa support rested at the 14- and 20-day moving averages, Gurner said.
Resistance was pegged at 1,031, the top of the channel for today and near Friday's high of 1,032, he said.
Despite the positive near-term outlook, cocoa was still in a wider range between about 1,060 and 980, the April 9 low.
